<!--
workflows/07_figures.Rmd - step 07 figures. Runs LOCALLY (laptop). Open in RStudio and click Knit:
  1. downloads the step 07 tables from the cluster (rsync over ssh; ~10-20 MB),
  2. draws every figure, saved as .svg and .pdf in <local>/figures/,
  3. writes this report, 07_figures.html, next to this file.
Needs the same one-time setup as 06d_figures.Rmd (R packages; SSH key to the cluster).
Inputs (made on the cluster by 07c and 07d):
  windows/  window_summary.tsv window_vs_outside.tsv cm_vs_none.tsv per_nt.tsv rna_summary.tsv
  cm/       cm_hits.tsv cm_positions.tsv cm_consensus.tsv cm_pairs.tsv superfold_pairs.tsv
Options (params above): fetch: false uses the tables already on disk; rnas picks the RNAs drawn
one by one (comma-separated accessions or RNA names).
-->

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ggplot2))
LOCAL <- path.expand(params$local)
NEED <- c("windows/window_summary.tsv", "windows/window_vs_outside.tsv", "windows/cm_vs_none.tsv",
          "windows/per_nt.tsv", "windows/rna_summary.tsv", "cm/cm_hits.tsv", "cm/cm_positions.tsv",
          "cm/cm_consensus.tsv", "cm/cm_pairs.tsv", "cm/superfold_pairs.tsv")

# ---- download ----
FETCH_LOG <- "download skipped (fetch: false)"
if (isTRUE(params$fetch)) {
  dir.create(LOCAL, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  inc <- c("--include=windows/", "--include=cm/", paste0("--include=", NEED),
           "--include=windows/entropy_drop*.tsv",                      # optional (07c --nodata)
           "--include=*/run_info.txt", "--exclude=*")
  out <- tryCatch(suppressWarnings(system2("rsync",
           c("-a", "--prune-empty-dirs", inc, shQuote(paste0(params$host, ":", params$remote, "/")), shQuote(paste0(LOCAL, "/"))),
           stdout = TRUE, stderr = TRUE, env = "RSYNC_RSH='ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=15'")),
           error = function(e) structure(conditionMessage(e), status = 1L))
  st <- attr(out, "status")
  if (!is.null(st) && st != 0) stop("Download from ", params$host, " failed:\n", paste(tail(out, 5), collapse = "\n"),
                                    "\nCheck the SSH key (see 06d_figures.Rmd), or set fetch: false.")
  FETCH_LOG <- paste0("downloaded from `", params$host, "` on ", format(Sys.time(), "%b %d %H:%M"))
}
miss <- NEED[!file.exists(file.path(LOCAL, NEED))]
if (length(miss)) stop("Missing inputs in ", LOCAL, ": ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "),
                       "\nRun 07c and 07d on the cluster first.")
FIG <- file.path(LOCAL, "figures")

# ---- style (same as 06d) ----
COLORS <- c("#2a78d6", "#eb6834", "#1baf7a", "#eda100", "#e87ba4", "#008300", "#4a3aa7", "#e34948")
CM_COLORS <- c(Class1a = "#e87ba4", Class1b = "#008300", Class2 = "#4a3aa7", cl3 = "#e34948",
               cl4 = "#eda100", none = "#c9c8c3")
INK <- "#0b0b0b"; INK2 <- "#52514e"; MUTED <- "#898781"; SURF <- "#fcfcfb"; NODATA <- "#e4e3df"
REACT_COLS <- c(low = "#2b2b2b", mid = "#f2a20d", high = "#d7191c", `no data` = "#d9d8d4")
theme_dms <- function(base = 9) {
  theme_classic(base_size = base) +
    theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = SURF, colour = NA),
          panel.background = element_rect(fill = SURF, colour = NA),
          axis.line = element_line(colour = MUTED, linewidth = 0.4),
          axis.ticks = element_line(colour = MUTED, linewidth = 0.4),
          axis.text = element_text(colour = INK2), axis.title = element_text(colour = INK2),
          plot.title = element_text(colour = INK, face = "bold", size = base + 2, hjust = 0),
          plot.title.position = "plot", plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = INK2, size = base - 1),
          strip.background = element_blank(),
          strip.text = element_text(colour = INK, face = "bold", hjust = 0, size = base + 1),
          legend.background = element_rect(fill = SURF, colour = NA),
          legend.key = element_rect(fill = SURF, colour = NA),
          legend.text = element_text(colour = INK2), legend.title = element_text(colour = INK2))
}
theme_set(theme_dms())

fig <- function(p, name, w, h) {
  dir.create(FIG, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  svg_dev <- if (requireNamespace("svglite", quietly = TRUE)) svglite::svglite else grDevices::svg
  pdf_dev <- if (capabilities("cairo")) grDevices::cairo_pdf else grDevices::pdf
  f <- file.path(FIG, name)
  ggsave(paste0(f, ".svg"), p, width = w, height = h, device = svg_dev, bg = SURF)
  ggsave(paste0(f, ".pdf"), p, width = w, height = h, device = pdf_dev, bg = SURF)
  knitr::include_graphics(normalizePath(paste0(f, ".svg")))
}
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (length(a) && !is.na(a[1])) a else b
rd <- function(f) read.delim(file.path(LOCAL, f), check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
fmt_p <- function(p) ifelse(is.na(p), "NA", ifelse(p < 0.001, formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 1), signif(p, 2)))
tbl <- function(d, digits = 3) knitr::kable(d, digits = digits, row.names = FALSE)
react_bin <- function(r) factor(ifelse(is.na(r), "no data", ifelse(r < 0.4, "low", ifelse(r < 0.85, "mid", "high"))),
                                levels = names(REACT_COLS))
# arcs: one semicircle per pair, above (side = 1) or below (side = -1) the axis
arcs <- function(P, side = 1, n = 40) {
  if (!nrow(P)) return(data.frame(x = numeric(), y = numeric(), id = character()))
  do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(P)), function(k) {
    i <- P$i[k]; j <- P$j[k]; t <- seq(0, pi, length.out = n)
    d <- data.frame(x = (i + j) / 2 + (j - i) / 2 * cos(t), y = side * (j - i) / 2 * sin(t), id = paste(side, k))
    cbind(d, P[rep(k, n), setdiff(names(P), c("i", "j")), drop = FALSE])
  }))
}
dotbracket <- function(P, from, to) {   # pairs inside [from, to] -> dot-bracket string
  s <- rep(".", to - from + 1)
  P <- P[P$i >= from & P$j <= to, , drop = FALSE]
  s[P$i - from + 1] <- "("; s[P$j - from + 1] <- ")"
  paste(s, collapse = "")
}

S <- rd("windows/window_summary.tsv"); TT <- rd("windows/window_vs_outside.tsv"); CMN <- rd("windows/cm_vs_none.tsv")
PN <- rd("windows/per_nt.tsv"); RS <- rd("windows/rna_summary.tsv")
H <- rd("cm/cm_hits.tsv"); CP <- rd("cm/cm_positions.tsv"); CC <- rd("cm/cm_consensus.tsv")
CMP <- rd("cm/cm_pairs.tsv"); SFP <- rd("cm/superfold_pairs.tsv")
tf <- function(v) toupper(as.character(v)) %in% c("TRUE", "T")     # Python True/False -> logical
RS$folded <- tf(RS$folded); RS$sf_regions_ok <- tf(RS$sf_regions_ok); SFP$in_mfe <- tf(SFP$in_mfe)
CP$cm_paired <- tf(CP$cm_paired); CP$superfold_paired <- tf(CP$superfold_paired)
```

Folder: ``r LOCAL`` (`r FETCH_LOG`). Figures: ``r FIG``.

SuperFold folded each whole RNA with its A/C DMS reactivities (SHAPE-style restraints, G/U and
positions under 2,000 reads blanked). `r sum(RS$folded)` of `r nrow(RS)` RNAs folded;
SuperFold's own low-reactivity/low-entropy regions are available for `r sum(RS$sf_regions_ok)`
(its last step failed on the others; entropy and structures are unaffected, and 07c computes the
regions itself).

## Stall windows vs the rest of each RNA

Every stall window is an Xrn1 hit. Each is compared with the rest of its own RNA (paired Wilcoxon).
Lower entropy = better-defined structure; lowSS = fraction of the window in low-reactivity /
low-entropy regions (51-nt medians, both below the RNA's median, runs of 40 nt or more).

```{r vs-outside}
tbl(TT, 4)
feats <- c(mean_entropy = "mean Shannon entropy", mean_entropy_covered = "entropy, data span only", frac_lowSS = "fraction in lowSS regions",
           median_reactivity = "median A/C reactivity", frac_low_reactivity = "fraction of A/C below 0.3")
d <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(feats), function(f) data.frame(
  feature = feats[[f]], outside = S[[paste0("out_", f)]], window = S[[paste0("win_", f)]],
  cm = ifelse(S$cm_class == "none", "no CM hit", "CM hit"))))
d <- d[complete.cases(d), ]; d$feature <- factor(d$feature, levels = feats)
lim <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(d, d$feature), function(x)
  data.frame(feature = x$feature[1], lo = min(x$outside, x$window), hi = max(x$outside, x$window))))
ta <- TT[TT$subset == "all" & TT$feature %in% names(feats), ]
ann <- merge(lim, data.frame(feature = unname(feats[ta$feature]), p = ta$wilcoxon_p, fh = ta$frac_window_higher))
ann$label <- sprintf("window higher in %.0f%%\np = %s", 100 * ann$fh, fmt_p(ann$p))
p <- ggplot(d, aes(outside, window)) +
  geom_segment(data = lim, aes(x = lo, y = lo, xend = hi, yend = hi), colour = MUTED, linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = cm), shape = 21, colour = SURF, size = 1.8, stroke = 0.4) +
  geom_label(data = ann, aes(x = lo, y = hi, label = label), hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 2.6,
             colour = INK2, fill = SURF, label.size = 0) +
  facet_wrap(~feature, nrow = 1, scales = "free") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("CM hit" = COLORS[1], "no CM hit" = COLORS[2]), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "rest of the RNA", y = "stall window", title = "SuperFold: stall window vs the rest of the same RNA; dashed = equal") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
fig(p, "superfold_window_vs_outside", 14, 3.8)
```

### How much the DMS data lower entropy

Only if 07c was run with `--nodata` (the sequence-only SuperFold run): for each window, entropy
without data minus entropy with data, inside the window and in the rest of its RNA. A larger drop
in the window means the data resolve the window more than the background.

```{r entropy-drop, eval = file.exists(file.path(LOCAL, "windows/entropy_drop.tsv"))}
ED <- rd("windows/entropy_drop.tsv"); EW <- rd("windows/entropy_drop_per_window.tsv")
tbl(ED, 4)
EW$cm <- ifelse(EW$cm_class == "none", "no CM hit", "CM hit")
lab <- data.frame(cm = ifelse(ED$subset == "CM hit", "CM hit", "no CM hit"), subset = ED$subset,
                  label = sprintf("window larger in %.0f%%\np = %s", 100 * ED$frac_window_larger, fmt_p(ED$wilcoxon_p)))
lab <- lab[lab$subset != "all", ]
lim <- range(c(EW$drop_rest, EW$drop_window))
p <- ggplot(EW, aes(drop_rest, drop_window)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, colour = MUTED, linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = cm), shape = 21, colour = SURF, size = 2, stroke = 0.4) +
  geom_label(data = lab, aes(x = lim[1], y = lim[2], label = label), hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 2.8,
             colour = INK2, fill = SURF, label.size = 0) +
  facet_wrap(~cm) + coord_equal(xlim = lim, ylim = lim) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("CM hit" = COLORS[1], "no CM hit" = COLORS[2]), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "entropy drop with data, rest of the RNA", y = "entropy drop with data, stall window",
       title = "How much the DMS data lower SuperFold entropy (sequence-only run minus data run)")
fig(p, "superfold_entropy_drop", 8, 4.4)
```

## Single RNAs

For each RNA: SuperFold base pairs as arcs above the axis (shade = pairing probability; dark
outline = in the SuperFold MFE structure), the CM consensus structure projected on the RNA below
the axis, DMS reactivity (A/C), and Shannon entropy. Then a zoom on each stall window with the
sequence colored by reactivity and the two structures as dot-brackets.

```{r single-setup}
want <- trimws(strsplit(params$rnas, ",")[[1]])
SEL <- unique(unlist(lapply(want, function(w) grep(w, unique(PN$rna), fixed = TRUE, value = TRUE))))
notfound <- want[!sapply(want, function(w) any(grepl(w, SEL, fixed = TRUE)))]
```

`r if (length(notfound)) paste0("Not in the folded RNAs (no DMS profile, e.g. genome-only accessions): ", paste(notfound, collapse = ", "), ".") else ""`

```{r single, results = "asis", fig.keep = "none"}
for (rna in SEL) {
  x <- PN[PN$rna == rna, ]; L <- max(x$nt)
  short <- sub("_inferred_3UTR|_3UTR|_intergenic", "", rna)
  sf <- SFP[SFP$rna == rna, ]; sf$prob[is.na(sf$prob)] <- 0.1
  cmp <- CMP[CMP$rna == rna, ]; hh <- H[H$rna == rna, ]; ww <- S[S$rna == rna, ]
  top <- max(c(1, (sf$j - sf$i) / 2)); bot <- max(c(1, (cmp$j - cmp$i) / 2))
  A1 <- arcs(sf[order(sf$prob), ], 1); A2 <- arcs(cmp, -1)
  rx <- x; rx$bin <- react_bin(rx$reactivity); rx$h <- ifelse(is.na(rx$reactivity), 0.15, pmin(rx$reactivity, 2))
  win <- data.frame(xmin = ww$stall_position + 1, xmax = ww$stall_position + 81)
  p1 <- ggplot() +
    geom_rect(data = win, aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -bot * 1.05, ymax = top * 1.05), fill = "#f1efe8") +
    geom_path(data = A1, aes(x, y, group = id, colour = prob), linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_path(data = A1[A1$in_mfe, ], aes(x, y, group = id), colour = INK, linewidth = 0.15) +
    geom_path(data = A2, aes(x, y, group = id), colour = CM_COLORS[[hh$cm_class[1] %||% "none"]], linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = MUTED, linewidth = 0.3) +
    annotate("text", x = 1, y = top * 0.95, label = "SuperFold", hjust = 0, size = 2.8, colour = INK2) +
    annotate("text", x = 1, y = -bot * 0.95, label = "CM consensus", hjust = 0, size = 2.8, colour = INK2) +
    scale_colour_gradient(low = "#c9d9f2", high = "#1f4e9c", limits = c(0, 1), name = "pairing\nprobability") +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, L + 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = short,
         subtitle = "Shaded: stall windows (stall site to +80 nt). Above: SuperFold pairs; below: CM consensus structure on this RNA.") +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), axis.line.y = element_blank())
  p2 <- ggplot(rx, aes(nt, h, fill = bin)) + geom_col(width = 1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = REACT_COLS, drop = FALSE, name = "DMS (A/C)") +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, L + 1), expand = c(0, 0)) + labs(x = NULL, y = "reactivity")
  p3 <- ggplot(x, aes(nt, entropy)) + geom_line(colour = COLORS[1], linewidth = 0.4) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, L + 1), expand = c(0, 0)) + labs(x = "nucleotide", y = "Shannon\nentropy")
  if (requireNamespace("patchwork", quietly = TRUE)) {
    p <- patchwork::wrap_plots(p1, p2, p3, ncol = 1, heights = c(3, 1, 0.8))
    cat("\n\n### ", short, "\n\n", sep = "")
    fig(p, paste0("rna_", short), 11, 6.5)
    cat("![](", normalizePath(file.path(FIG, paste0("rna_", short, ".svg"))), ")\n\n", sep = "")
  } else {
    cat("\n\n### ", short, "\n\n", sep = "")
    for (k in 1:3) { nm <- paste0("rna_", short, "_", c("arcs", "reactivity", "entropy")[k])
      fig(list(p1, p2, p3)[[k]], nm, 11, c(3.5, 1.4, 1.2)[k])
      cat("![](", normalizePath(file.path(FIG, paste0(nm, ".svg"))), ")\n\n", sep = "") }
  }
  # zoom on each window with a CM hit (or the window itself)
  for (k in seq_len(nrow(ww))) {
    w <- ww[k, ]; hk <- hh[hh$window == w$window, ]
    from <- if (nrow(hk)) max(1, hk$hit_from - 5) else w$stall_position + 1
    to <- if (nrow(hk)) min(L, hk$hit_to + 5) else min(L, w$stall_position + 81)
    z <- x[x$nt >= from & x$nt <= to, ]; z$bin <- react_bin(z$reactivity)
    db_sf <- dotbracket(sf[sf$in_mfe, ], from, to); db_cm <- dotbracket(cmp[cmp$window == w$window, ], from, to)
    zz <- rbind(data.frame(nt = z$nt, row = "sequence", ch = z$base, bin = z$bin),
                data.frame(nt = z$nt, row = "SuperFold MFE", ch = strsplit(db_sf, "")[[1]], bin = z$bin),
                data.frame(nt = z$nt, row = "CM consensus", ch = strsplit(db_cm, "")[[1]], bin = z$bin))
    zz$row <- factor(zz$row, levels = c("CM consensus", "SuperFold MFE", "sequence"))
    stall <- w$stall_position + 1
    pz <- ggplot(zz, aes(nt, row)) +
      geom_tile(data = zz[zz$row == "sequence", ], aes(fill = bin), height = 0.8) +
      geom_text(aes(label = ch, colour = row == "sequence" & bin %in% c("low", "high")), size = 3.4, family = "mono", fontface = "bold") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = stall - 0.5, colour = COLORS[2], linewidth = 0.5) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = REACT_COLS, drop = FALSE, name = "DMS (A/C)") +
      scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "white", `FALSE` = INK), guide = "none") +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(ceiling(from / 10) * 10, to, 10), expand = c(0.01, 0)) +
      labs(x = "nucleotide", y = NULL,
           title = sprintf("%s, stall at nt %d (orange line)%s", short, stall,
                           if (nrow(hk)) sprintf("; %s hit nt %d-%d, E = %s", hk$cm_class, hk$hit_from, hk$hit_to, fmt_p(hk$evalue)) else ""))
    nm <- paste0("rna_", short, "_window", stall)
    fig(pz, nm, max(6, 0.13 * (to - from + 1) + 1.5), 2.2)
    cat("![](", normalizePath(file.path(FIG, paste0(nm, ".svg"))), ")\n\n", sep = "")
    cat("```\n", sprintf("%-14s %s\n%-14s %s\n%-14s %s\n", "sequence", paste(z$base, collapse = ""),
                         "SuperFold MFE", db_sf, "CM consensus", db_cm), "```\n\n", sep = "")
  }
}
```

## By CM class (all windows of a class on the CM's consensus positions)

Each window was searched with its class's CM (07d, Infernal `cmsearch`), so its nucleotides line up
with the CM's consensus positions. Per position: the median DMS reactivity across windows (A/C
only), whether the CM says it is paired, and how often SuperFold pairs it. If the data agree with
the CM structure, CM-paired positions are less reactive.

```{r class-agree}
ag <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(CP, CP$cm_class), function(x) {
  a <- x$reactivity[x$cm_paired & !is.na(x$reactivity)]; b <- x$reactivity[!x$cm_paired & !is.na(x$reactivity)]
  data.frame(cm_class = x$cm_class[1], n_windows = length(unique(x$window)),
             median_paired = median(a), median_unpaired = median(b), n_paired = length(a), n_unpaired = length(b),
             mannwhitney_p = if (length(a) > 2 && length(b) > 2) wilcox.test(a, b)$p.value else NA,
             superfold_agrees = mean((x$superfold_paired %in% TRUE) == x$cm_paired, na.rm = TRUE))
}))
tbl(ag, 4)
```

`superfold_agrees` = fraction of aligned positions where SuperFold's MFE and the CM agree on paired vs unpaired.

```{r class-figs, results = "asis", fig.keep = "none"}
for (cls in intersect(names(CM_COLORS), unique(CP$cm_class))) {
  x <- CP[CP$cm_class == cls, ]; cc <- CC[CC$cm_class == cls, ]; n <- max(cc$cons_pos)
  m <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(x, x$cons_pos), function(y) data.frame(
    cons_pos = y$cons_pos[1], med = median(y$reactivity, na.rm = TRUE),
    q1 = quantile(y$reactivity, .25, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE), q3 = quantile(y$reactivity, .75, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE),
    n = sum(!is.na(y$reactivity)), sf_paired = mean(y$superfold_paired %in% TRUE))))
  m <- merge(m, cc[, c("cons_pos", "cons_base", "dot_bracket")], all.y = TRUE)
  m$cm <- ifelse(m$dot_bracket == ".", "unpaired in CM", "paired in CM")
  lab <- data.frame(cons_pos = cc$cons_pos, y = -0.18, ch = cc$dot_bracket, base = toupper(cc$cons_base))
  pa <- ggplot(m, aes(cons_pos)) +
    geom_col(aes(y = ifelse(n >= 2, med, NA), fill = cm), width = 0.85, na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ifelse(n >= 2, q1, NA), ymax = ifelse(n >= 2, q3, NA)), width = 0.3, colour = MUTED, linewidth = 0.3, na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_text(data = lab, aes(y = y, label = ch), size = 2.6, family = "mono", colour = INK) +
    geom_text(data = lab, aes(y = y - 0.14, label = base), size = 2.2, family = "mono", colour = INK2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(`paired in CM` = CM_COLORS[[cls]], `unpaired in CM` = MUTED), name = NULL) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, n, 10), expand = c(0.01, 0)) +
    labs(x = "CM consensus position", y = "DMS reactivity\n(median, IQR)",
         title = sprintf("%s: %d windows on the CM consensus", cls, length(unique(x$window))),
         subtitle = "Bars: median A/C reactivity (positions with data in >= 2 windows). Below: CM consensus structure and sequence.") +
    theme(legend.position = "top")
  x$bin <- react_bin(x$reactivity)
  ord <- unique(x$window[order(x$rna)])
  x$label <- factor(sub("_inferred_3UTR|_3UTR|_intergenic", "", x$window), levels = sub("_inferred_3UTR|_3UTR|_intergenic", "", rev(ord)))
  ph <- ggplot(x, aes(cons_pos, label, fill = bin)) + geom_tile(height = 0.9) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = REACT_COLS, drop = FALSE, name = "DMS (A/C)") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, n, 10), expand = c(0.01, 0)) +
    labs(x = "CM consensus position", y = NULL, title = sprintf("%s: each window (gray = G/U, low depth, or deletion)", cls)) +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6))
  cat("\n\n### ", cls, "\n\n", sep = "")
  fig(pa, paste0("class_", cls, "_consensus"), max(7, 0.12 * n + 2), 3.6)
  cat("![](", normalizePath(file.path(FIG, paste0("class_", cls, "_consensus.svg"))), ")\n\n", sep = "")
  fig(ph, paste0("class_", cls, "_heatmap"), max(7, 0.12 * n + 2), 1.2 + 0.16 * length(ord))
  cat("![](", normalizePath(file.path(FIG, paste0("class_", cls, "_heatmap.svg"))), ")\n\n", sep = "")
}
```
